description: Create a PromptEden monitor via POST /api/v1/monitors. Requires projectSlug or projectId. Defaults: type='search', language='en', country='US' (applied by the shared client). Only provider keys present in the filtered list_providers catalog are accepted. This starts recurring metered runs and uses credits.

projectId.description: Project id. Required unless projectSlug is supplied.

projectSlug.description: Project slug. Required unless projectId is supplied.
